newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan CPI up 0.4 percent in December 1996.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan CPI up 0.4 percent in December 1996.

text.p: Morocco's consumer price index (CPI) rose 0.4 percent to 148.7 points in December from 148.1 in November, an official report said on Tuesday.
The Statistics Directorate attributed the increase to a rise in food costs, up 0.7 percent, and services rising 0.4 percent.
The average rise for the CPI in the whole year was 3.0 percent compared with 6.1 percent in 1995.
The base year for the index set at 100 points is 1989.
